info.title: Tripinly API
info.description: REST API for the Tripinly apps. Errors use `{ error: { code, message, details } }`; switch on `code`.

migrations.description: down while a migration this build ships with is not applied, or one failed

message.description: Localized, human-readable text. Never switch on it.

details.description: Extra data for the code. VALIDATION_FAILED carries `fields`: { "<path>": ["<constraint>"] }.

placesRefreshSeconds.description: Seconds a map square's places stay fresh. The app keeps showing older ones and reloads them in the background when they come into view.

photoMaxEdgePx.description: Longest edge, in pixels, the app shrinks a photo to before uploading it.

photoJpegQuality.description: JPEG quality (50–100) the app encodes photos with before uploading.

photoParallelUploads.description: How many photos the app uploads at the same time.

pinLargeMinProminence.description: A place's `prominence` from which its map pin is drawn largest.

pinMediumMinProminence.description: A place's `prominence` from which its map pin is drawn middle-sized; below it, smallest.

mapMaxPins.description: Most place pins the app draws on the map at once: liked places first, then the best known.

photoPinMinProminence.description: A place's pin shows its photo (`coverThumbUrl`) when its `prominence` is at least this, or it has `photoPinMinLikes` likes.

photoPinMinLikes.description: A place's pin shows its photo when it has at least this many likes, or `photoPinMinProminence`.

mapMaxPhotoPins.description: Most pins the app draws with a photo at once, in pin order (liked places first, then the best known); the rest keep their icon.

pinDotBelowZoom.description: Below this camera zoom (0–22), the app draws place pins as small dots, growing back to pins when zoomed in; the tapped place stays a pin.

event.description: The RevenueCat event; `app_user_id`, `aliases`, `transferred_from` and `transferred_to` name the customers to sync

idToken.description: Google ID token from the Credential Manager / Google Sign-In SDK

refreshToken.description: Single use: each refresh returns a new one

onboardingRequired.description: Profile or consents still missing: show onboarding

identityToken.description: Identity token (JWT) from Sign in with Apple

authorizationCode.description: Authorization code; exchanged for a token used to revoke the Apple session on account deletion

givenName.description: Apple sends the name only on the first sign-in

subject.description: Any stable test identifier; the same subject signs in to the same account

fcmToken.description: This device's FCM token, unregistered from push

required.description: Must be accepted before using the app

completed.description: Profile complete and all required consents given

birthDate.description: Only ever returned to its owner

entitlements.description: Active premium features. Show paid UI from this, never from a local flag.

username.description: Set during onboarding; afterwards changeable once every 30 days

birthDate.description: Onboarding only. Users must be 16 or older.

granted.description: Currently granted (latest record is a grant)

missingRequired.description: Required documents still to accept (current versions)

version.description: The version shown to the user; must be current when granting

granted.description: true to grant, false to withdraw

locale.description: Device language, used to localize push

coverPhotoId.description: The cover photo shown as coverThumbUrl: cache the image by this id, since the URL is re-signed

coverThumbUrl.description: First cover photo in the trip (from stage 5)

editorCount.description: People the trip is shared with as editors (the owner not counted)

savedByMe.description: In my trips because I saved it (role is viewer then, unless I am also a member)

createdAt.description: When the trip was created (apps show "3 days ago")

followerCount.description: People who follow them (leaves out suspended users and anyone with a block with me)

followingCount.description: People they follow (leaves out suspended users and anyone with a block with me)

isFriend.description: We follow each other; they appear in my friends list

trips.description: Their public trips, most recently changed first

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for more trips
Pass as cursor for the next page

startDate.description: Without dates the trip has one "Day 1"

endDate.description: Needs startDate; one day is created per date (max 20)

destination.description: Where the trip goes, e.g. a city from GET /places/search. The map opens there while the trip has no markers

memberUsernames.description: Added as editors. The trip holds at most APP_TRIP_MAX_MEMBERS people (default 50), owner included

likeCount.description: The place's likes: a stop's like button likes its place, so every stop at a place shows the same count

canLike.description: False for a custom spot that is only in private trips: it has no like button

createdBy.description: Null after the creator deleted their account

position.description: 0-based; the client shows "Day n" as position + 1

savedByMe.description: The trip is in my trips as a saved trip

myJoinRequest.description: My request to join: pending until the owner decides; declined stays declined. Null when I have none (also once accepted: I am a member then).

pendingJoinRequestCount.description: Requests waiting for the owner; 0 for everyone else

startDate.description: null removes the dates (days stay, shown as "Day n")

endDate.description: Resizes the trip: adds empty days, or removes trailing days if they have no markers (else 400 fields.endDate = ["daysNotEmpty"])

tripCount.description: Trips I own or collaborate on

name.description: Localized from OSM name:<lang> when available

isTripinly.description: Liked on Tripinly (popularity > 0); show the Tripinly pin style

likeCount.description: Popularity: likes on public markers here + place likes

prominence.description: How well known the place is, 0–100, from QRank (Wikimedia page views) and OSM tags; 0 when unknown. Size map pins by it (thresholds in GET /v1/app-config)

coverPhotoId.description: Id of the cover when it is a Tripinly photo (a place photo or a trip photo), or null (a Commons cover has only coverImageId)

coverImageId.description: Id of the cover image, a Tripinly photo or a Commons image (stable; cache the image by it and coverSource), or null

coverSource.description: `trip`: a Tripinly photo (a place photo or a trip photo); `commons`: a Wikimedia Commons image (credit it on tap from GET /places/{id}); null without a cover

coverThumbUrl.description: Thumbnail of the cover, also drawn in the map pin: the place's photo, or a photo on a stop here in a public trip, with the most likes, once at least APP_PLACE_PHOTO_PIN_MIN_LIKES (3) people other than its uploader liked it (ties: the newest); else the place's first Wikimedia Commons image; signed, valid ≥ 1 h

places.description: Tripinly places first (by popularity), then OSM places from zoom 14

clusters.description: Below zoom 14, when there are more Tripinly places than `limit`; else empty

places.description: What in-view returns for the square

source.description: place: one of our places (send placeId). photon: an address, street or city (send name + location + osmType/osmId).

id.description: Our place id; null for photon

type.description: Photon type: house, street, locality, district, city, county, state, country, other

address.description: Photon: street, city and country for telling results apart

items.description: Our places first, then Photon results we do not already have

name.description: Localized from OSM name:<lang> when available

isTripinly.description: Liked on Tripinly (popularity > 0); show the Tripinly pin style

likeCount.description: Popularity: likes on public markers here + place likes

prominence.description: How well known the place is, 0–100, from QRank (Wikimedia page views) and OSM tags; 0 when unknown. Size map pins by it (thresholds in GET /v1/app-config)

coverPhotoId.description: Id of the cover when it is a Tripinly photo (a place photo or a trip photo), or null (a Commons cover has only coverImageId)

coverImageId.description: Id of the cover image, a Tripinly photo or a Commons image (stable; cache the image by it and coverSource), or null

coverSource.description: `trip`: a Tripinly photo (a place photo or a trip photo); `commons`: a Wikimedia Commons image (credit it on tap from GET /places/{id}); null without a cover

coverThumbUrl.description: Thumbnail of the cover, also drawn in the map pin: the place's photo, or a photo on a stop here in a public trip, with the most likes, once at least APP_PLACE_PHOTO_PIN_MIN_LIKES (3) people other than its uploader liked it (ties: the newest); else the place's first Wikimedia Commons image; signed, valid ≥ 1 h

distanceMeters.description: From the query point, in metres

items.description: Tripinly places by popularity and distance. When fewer than 10 are in range, the first page is topped up with OSM sights by distance.

author.description: Who to credit (the uploader's own wording when given)

title.description: Title of the work; set only where the licence requires it (CC before 4.0)

sourceUrl.description: The file page on Wikimedia Commons; link the author here

id.description: Stable; cache the image by it and source

displayUrl.description: Up to 1600 px (trip) or 1280 px wide (Commons), uncropped; signed, valid ≥ 1 h

credit.description: For Commons images: show "© author · licence · Wikimedia Commons" under the image (with the title first when set, and "· cropped" where the app crops it). Null for trip photos

name.description: Localized from OSM name:<lang> when available

isTripinly.description: Liked on Tripinly (popularity > 0); show the Tripinly pin style

likeCount.description: Popularity: likes on public markers here + place likes

prominence.description: How well known the place is, 0–100, from QRank (Wikimedia page views) and OSM tags; 0 when unknown. Size map pins by it (thresholds in GET /v1/app-config)

coverPhotoId.description: Id of the cover when it is a Tripinly photo (a place photo or a trip photo), or null (a Commons cover has only coverImageId)

coverImageId.description: Id of the cover image, a Tripinly photo or a Commons image (stable; cache the image by it and coverSource), or null

coverSource.description: `trip`: a Tripinly photo (a place photo or a trip photo); `commons`: a Wikimedia Commons image (credit it on tap from GET /places/{id}); null without a cover

coverThumbUrl.description: Thumbnail of the cover, also drawn in the map pin: the place's photo, or a photo on a stop here in a public trip, with the most likes, once at least APP_PLACE_PHOTO_PIN_MIN_LIKES (3) people other than its uploader liked it (ties: the newest); else the place's first Wikimedia Commons image; signed, valid ≥ 1 h

isActive.description: false when OSM no longer has it; existing markers keep it

photoThumbUrls.description: Use images. Up to 10 photos that may represent the place (same rule as coverThumbUrl), most likes first

images.description: Images for the card: up to 10 photos that may represent the place (place photos and public trip photos, most likes first), then its Wikimedia Commons images. The first one is the cover

id.description: Client-chosen ID, so the app can show the marker before the response; 409 ID_CONFLICT if taken

placeId.description: A place from our in-view, search or along-the-way results. Omit when sending location.

name.description: With location: the custom pin or Photon result name; leave it out for a tap on the map and the server names the stop. With placeId, overrides the place name.

location.description: Custom pin or Photon result. Omit when sending placeId.

osmType.description: From a Photon result, with osmId

osmId.description: From a Photon result, with osmType

category.description: Category for a new place; defaults to other

position.description: Insert position in the day; appended when omitted

dayId.description: A day of a trip I own or edit

position.description: Insert position in the day; appended when omitted

location.description: Move the pin; the place is matched again

dayId.description: Move to another day of the same trip

markerIds.description: All of the day's marker IDs in the new order

url.description: Only returned when the invite is created

token.description: Only returned when the invite is created

alreadyMember.description: The caller is already a member

bytes.description: Size of the file to upload. Over 15728640 bytes → 413 UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE

markerId.description: The stop of a trip photo; null for a place photo

placeId.description: The place of a place photo; null for a trip photo

status.description: Only ready photos are shown to viewers; editors also see processing and failed ones

thumbUrl.description: 256 px square, signed, valid ≥ 1 h; null until ready

displayUrl.description: ≤ 1600 px long edge, signed, valid ≥ 1 h; null until ready

source.description: `user`: uploaded by someone in the app. `commons`: one of a place's Wikimedia Commons images, only in a place's Photos list; like it with targetType place_image, and show its credit

credit.description: Commons images only: show "© author · licence · Wikimedia Commons" with it. Null for photos people uploaded

uploadUrl.description: PUT the file here with exactly the headers below

uploadHeaders.description: Send these headers with the PUT

expiresAt.description: The upload URL stops working after this (10 minutes)

photoIds.description: Exactly the marker's processing and ready photos, in the new order

photoId.description: A ready photo of this marker

canDelete.description: I wrote it, or I own the trip

likeCount.description: The target's like count after the change (a place's popularity for places)

positionAlongRoute.description: 0 at the start, 1 at the end

route.description: Null for a day with fewer than two markers

degraded.description: True when routing is unavailable (quota used up, not configured): the route is straight lines with estimated times

markerIds.description: Proposed order; the first marker stays first

mode.description: travel_time, or straight_line when travel times are unavailable

savedMinutes.description: Minutes saved against the current order (travel_time only)

degraded.description: Travel times were unavailable: straight_line was used

actor.description: Who caused it (the latest person for grouped types)

count.description: trip_changed_by_collaborator: number of changes; likes_grouped: number of people; else 1

title.description: Localized, same text as the push

updatedAt.description: Grouped types keep collecting until their push goes out; the same id may arrive again with a higher count

ids.description: Mark these as read. Send either ids or all.

commentOnMarker.description: Push for comments on my places

addedToTrip.description: Push when someone adds me to a trip

tripChangedByCollaborator.description: Push for collaborator changes (batched per 10 minutes)

likesGrouped.description: Push for likes (at most one per hour)

joinRequested.description: Push when someone asks to join my trip

token.description: Google ID token or Apple identity token, as for POST /auth/google or /auth/apple

expiresAt.description: The file and its link are deleted at this time.

downloadUrl.description: Signed ZIP download link while ready, valid until expiresAt. Never log it.

exists.description: False once the target was deleted.

owner.description: The reported user, or the owner/author of the content.

text.description: Trip title, marker name, comment body or display name. Photos: null.

hidden.description: Hidden by moderation, or the user is suspended.

reporter.description: Null once the reporter deleted their account.

openReportCount.description: Open reports on the same target, this one included.

action.description: hide_content and delete_content need a trip, marker, photo or comment; suspend_user suspends the reported user or the author of the reported content.
